summary: AI-Based Skill Gap Analyzer for Students - A full-stack web application that analyzes student resumes using NLP, compares extracted skills with industry job role requirements, identifies skill gaps, and provides personalized recommendations with downloadable PDF reports.
architectural_notes: Frontend: React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS for responsive UI
Backend: Motoko canisters for data storage (users, resumes, job roles, skills)
NLP Integration: Frontend TypeScript calls external NLP APIs for text extraction
Authentication: Internet Identity integration (passkeys, Google, Apple, Microsoft)
Data Storage: Resumes stored permanently in canisters with analysis history
Admin Access: Role-based access control for job role and skills management
Skills Structure: Includes proficiency levels and skill categories (Technical/Soft)
Matching Algorithm: TF-IDF with cosine similarity for skill comparison
PDF Generation: Frontend JavaScript library for report generation
REST API Architecture: Modular canister methods with proper error handling

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system using Internet Identity integration allowing users to register and login with passkeys, Google, Apple, or Microsoft accounts
Create resume upload functionality accepting PDF format with file validation checking file type, size limits, and proper error messaging for invalid uploads
Implement resume parsing by calling external NLP API from frontend TypeScript code to extract text content from uploaded PDF files
Build skill extraction functionality that analyzes parsed resume text using NLP techniques to identify technical and soft skills mentioned in the resume
Create admin interface with role-based access control where authorized admin users can add, edit, and delete job roles with their associated required skills
Build skill matching algorithm using cosine similarity to compare extracted resume skills against selected job role requirements and calculate match percentage
Create missing skills identification feature that analyzes skill gaps by comparing resume skills against job requirements and generates a list of skills the student needs to acquire
Implement recommendation engine that suggests relevant courses and projects based on identified skill gaps to help students acquire missing skills
Build interactive dashboard with graphical visualizations including charts showing skill match percentage, matching skills breakdown, missing skills analysis, and comparison metrics
Create PDF report generation feature allowing users to download a comprehensive analysis report containing match percentage, matching skills, missing skills, and course recommendations

Design a cohesive visual theme with a professional, education-focused aesthetic using clean typography, a modern color palette (avoiding blue and purple unless specifically requested), and a layout that emphasizes clarity and data visualization
Implement user selection interface for predefined job roles including Data Analyst, Web Developer, AI Engineer, and other roles managed through the admin interface
Update the job role selector component to handle the case where job roles are being loaded or seeded, showing an appropriate loading state instead of the 'No job roles available' error message

Update the JobRoleSelector component to show a loading state while job roles are being fetched or seeded, displaying a spinner or skeleton loader instead of the 'No job roles available. Please contact an administrator.' error message when roles are still being initialized
